name: trace_id
description: W3C 32-hex trace identifier.

name: span_id
description: Span identifier of the kept tool, retrieval, or memory call (client span when server span folds).

name: parent_span_id
description: Parent span identifier on the kept call span.

name: outcome_id
description: Primary outcome.id of the span or enclosing trace.

name: trace_owner_app_id
description: Owning application ID of the trace (NULL when unregistered).

name: tool_call_id
description: gen_ai.tool.call.id call correlation identifier.

name: operation_name
description: gen_ai.operation.name (execute_tool, retrieval, or memory_*).

name: start_time
description: Call start UTC timestamp.

name: end_time
description: Call end UTC timestamp.

name: duration_ms
description: Call execution duration in milliseconds (end_time minus start_time).

name: agent_id
description: gen_ai.agent.id on the call, else on the nearest enclosing agent span.

name: agent_name
description: gen_ai.agent.name on the call, else on the nearest enclosing agent span.

name: skill_name
description: gen_ai.skill.name on the call or nearest enclosing agent span.

name: skill_version
description: bq_eval.skill_version on the call or nearest enclosing agent span.

name: skill_sha256
description: Emitted bq_eval.skill_sha256 hex digest.

name: tool_name
description: gen_ai.tool.name invoked tool identifier.

name: span_status
description: Normalized span status: OK, ERROR, or UNSET.

name: action_id
description: bq_eval.action_id binding mutating tool calls to approvals and commits.

name: args_hash_source
description: Source of args_sha256: proxy, silver, application, or none (ADR-041, ADR-045).

name: args_hash_attested
description: TRUE only when args_hash_source is proxy; FALSE for silver or application; NULL when args_hash_source is none (open twin omits args_sha256, ADR-038).

name: authz_mode
description: bq_eval.authz_mode (parameter_matched or token_enforced).

name: data_source_id
description: gen_ai.data_source.id retrieval or memory corpus identifier.

name: acl_dropped_count
description: bq_eval.acl_dropped_count chunks dropped by pre-retrieval ACL filters.

name: memory_op
description: bq_eval.memory_op (read, write, update, delete).

name: job_id
description: db.query.job_id downstream warehouse job identifier.

name: bytes_scanned
description: db.query.bytes_scanned bytes scanned by warehouse query.

name: bytes_billed
description: db.query.bytes_billed bytes billed by warehouse query.

name: slot_ms
description: db.query.slot_ms slot milliseconds consumed by warehouse query.

name: sandbox_cpu_sec
description: bq_eval.sandbox.cpu_sec sandbox CPU seconds.

name: sandbox_mem_gb_sec
description: bq_eval.sandbox.mem_gb_sec sandbox memory GiB-seconds.

name: sandbox_status
description: bq_eval.sandbox.status (ok, timeout, error, policy_blocked).

name: content_missing
description: TRUE when the call lacks inline arguments/results and its trace has no Shape-3 reference (open twin never scans restricted Shape-3 buckets, ADR-038).

name: repeat_number
description: Dense rank per trace of equal tool_name and arguments in order of first (start_time, span_id); NULL when args_hash_source is none.

name: writes_state
description: SCD-2 tools.writes_state capability flag (NULL when tool is unregistered).

name: modifies_workspace
description: SCD-2 tools.modifies_workspace capability flag.

name: executes_code
description: SCD-2 tools.executes_code capability flag.

name: sends_external_reply
description: SCD-2 tools.sends_external_reply capability flag.

name: returns_pii
description: SCD-2 tools.returns_pii capability flag.

name: creates_ticket
description: SCD-2 tools.creates_ticket capability flag.

name: labels
description: Open-safe registered slice-only attributes JSON object.
